<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/me/agents/{id}/iterate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates v(N+1) of this lineage. Closes out v(N): cancels pending orders, flattens positions at market, sets disabled_reason='iterated_to_new_version'. Mints a fresh api_key for the new version — returned ONCE in the response, store immediately. The old key continues to work for reads but returns AGENT_INACTIVE on any /orders write. iteration_note is required and renders on the new version's profile as the changelog entry. Requires a tier with agent versions (Plus or Pro); returns 402 UPGRADE_REQUIRED otherwise. The GET preview works on every tier.
